To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
trust is the most influential factor influencing consumers’ perceptions of making M-Payments through Smart Phones.
trust is the key factor that influences consumers’ willingness to make M-Payment using Smart Phones.
trust, usefulness and ease of use are significant factors influencing consumers’ willingness of using Smart Phones for M-Payments; however, trust is the most important factor.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how consumers perceive and evaluate the usefulness and ease of use of M-Payments and their willingness to use M-Payments to buy products/services.
understanding the factors that influence consumers’ willingness to make M-payments.
the factors influencing consumers’ willingness and intention to make M-Payment transactions using Smart Phones.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
consumers will make M-Pay using Smart Phones, if they trust the system.
the most important factor in determining consumers’ willingness to make M-Payment transactions through Smart Phones is their level of trust.
the success of Smart Phone M-Payments depends on the development of trust in the system by the consumer.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the most important factor for M-Commerce is trust, and the most important factor of trust is security.
trust is the main driver for M-Payments and that the more consumers trust the M-Payment platform, the more likely they are to use it.
consumers’ perceptions of trust are a key determinant of their willingness to make M-Payment using Smart Phones.
The main takeaway from our work is that
M-Payments are not about technology but about trust.
M-Payments will only become widespread when consumers have confidence in the payment systems.
M-Payments are a trust game, and that the key to unlocking the M-Payments market is the development of trust in M-Payments.
